_comment: Facts that repeat across the site. Referenced from markup as {{phone.display}}.
Change a value here and every page that uses it changes on the next build —
that is the whole point: the annual price adjustment used to be 54 hand edits.
The build FAILS on an unknown placeholder, so a typo can never ship as literal
'{{...}}' text. Keep this file free of anything that is not a plain fact:
no markup, no copy, no per-page prose.

counters._comment: Cifras del Live-Entwurf. 300+/1.000.000+/10+ siguen SIN confirmar por el cliente (CLAUDE.md). 'count' es el valor crudo que lee el contador animado; el resto es como se muestra.

_comment: ALL PRICE NUMBERS ON THE SITE LIVE HERE (client rule G10, 2026-08-14: 'all price
values are adjusted once per year on our side — keep them editable in one place,
the update must be a 5-minute content edit'). Nothing below may be re-typed into
a page: every occurrence is a {{price.*}} token, so changing a number here changes
every page that states it, including the JSON-LD copies.
WHAT TO EDIT ONCE A YEAR:
min / max        the hourly range. `range` is the same pair joined with a hyphen
for the price box; keep all three in step.
surcharge.*      the collective-agreement percentages (Lohntarifvertrag Bayern).
example.*        the worked examples in the cost guide. These are DERIVED from
the rate, the hours and the surcharges — recompute them when the
rate moves, they do not update themselves.
guideYear        the year in the cost guide's <title> and og:title.
Source: the client's Webtexte, Stand 04.08.2026.
RENAMED 2026-08-09 from 'werkschutz' to 'range': the Webtexte publish the SAME
26-32 for every service and city, so a service-specific key invited a second,
drifting copy of one number. If a service ever gets its own range, add a key for
THAT service and leave this one as the default.

_priceBoxComment: Defaults for partials/price-box.html, added 2026-08-16 for the nine service
pages. Same mechanism and same reason as nameRequired/companyRequired below:
an include's own parameters WIN over this file, so a page overrides one line
by passing e.g. priceBoxTick1="Kurzfristig verfügbar nach Absprache" and every
other page keeps the default without being edited. They live at the TOP LEVEL
because an include parameter is a flat key and cannot override a nested one.
Why they exist: each Webtext specifies its own Preis-Box lines, and /brandwache/
specifies a PHONE CTA there rather than the form (its whole page inverts the CTA
order — client rule G2, the one approved exception). Before this the box was
fixed, so those lines were the one part of a draft the price section could not
state. Nothing about the 11 pages that already include the box changed.
_formComment: nameRequired/companyRequired: banderas del partial lead-form. Por defecto ambos obligatorios; una página las sobrescribe en su include, p.ej. nameRequired="" para bajar la fricción en una landing de Ads. Van al nivel superior porque un parámetro de include es una clave plana y no puede sobrescribir una anidada.
